capabilities: Display sections separated by root-level --- lines one at a time as cards
Navigate between sections with hotkeys, arrow keys, or mobile edge taps
Switch between native Reading and Editing views while keeping section focus
Resume the saved reading position per note
Jump between sections via the Outline and same-note heading, block, and footnote links
disambiguation: Not a note splitter; the note remains a single file and sections are only filtered visually.
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No toggle hotkey is assigned by default; users must set one under Settings → Hotkeys. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: Section Reader adds section focus to Obsidian's native Markdown view
problem: Long notes stack many concepts top to bottom, making it easy to lose focus while reading and reviewing unless you manually split the note into multiple files.

relations.evidence: With Hover Editor enabled, the same interactive preview popovers are available in card mode
Use the native editor to annotate text or run editor commands such as Templater

summary: Section focus view that shows long Markdown notes one root-level section at a time as cards while the file stays whole.
